[recalibrated 2026-05-19] OKX announcement explicitly states 'Estimated share count: 1,000,000,000' and '1 SPACEX ≈ 1/1,000,000,000 of the company's market cap'. OKX prices the contract against an indexed valuation model with a 1B-share denominator, not actual fully-diluted shares. Derivation: share_ratio = fully_diluted_shares / OKX_estimated_basis = 11.87B / 1B = 11.87. Sanity check: at token price P, OKX-intended FDV = P × 1B; our normalizer = (P / 11.87) × 11.87B = P × 1B. ✅ Trigger for recalibration: when SpaceX files S-1, OKX will execute a proportional rebase to preserve position value (1 SPACEX = 1 actual share post-rebase) - bump share_ratio accordingly and update ratio_calibrated_at. Instrument metadata (ctVal=1, ctValCcy=SPACEX, ctMult=1) describes 1 contract = 1 SPACEX unit; the unit's economic meaning is set by the announcement, not by ctVal.
